To find the percentage by which the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fell short of the baseline's, we can use the following calculation:

((205.6 - 194.0) / 205.6) * 100% ≈ 5.6%

So the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fell short of the baseline's by approximately 5.6%.
